_fixture: SYNTHETIC-FIXTURE / T1 observations for ProtView M22 GA. Oracle paths come from independent_ga_oracle.py (standard library, no mw import); SYNTHETIC scores are selection-logic inputs, never engine output; observed scores are real qvina2 outputs recorded as observations. See SYNTHETIC-PROVENANCE.md and docs/qa/m22-ga-20261004/preflight.txt.

assumptions.A1: Generation g's individual order is carried first (elite order: score ascending, ties pool order), then the new individuals in evaluation order (= selection order: similar slots, then random slots).
assumptions.A2: 'Not yet picked' means not picked anywhere in this run so far, including earlier slots of the generation being built; carried individuals were picked when first chosen.
assumptions.A3: A generation stopped midway lists its carried individuals and the individuals evaluated before the stop; selected-but-not-evaluated individuals are not listed.
assumptions.A4: When the patience counter reaches 'patience' at the last generation (g == generations), the stop reason is generations_complete (nothing was stopped early).
assumptions.A5: Running minimum: None (no score yet) -> a number counts as decreased; None -> None and x -> y with y >= x count as not decreased.
assumptions.A6: When no unpicked eligible candidate is left, no further rng call is made (the remaining slots stay empty); this cannot change the outcome because nothing can be picked afterwards.
assumptions.A7: A generation whose new slots are all unfilled is not recorded; the run ends with pool_exhausted and generations_done = the last recorded generation.

small_observed_seed7.how: small pool, observed fast-docking first-mode scores (t1_observations.small_pool_docking), no reuse

small_observed_seed7_reuse_two.how: same as small_observed_seed7 with two candidates reusable: same path (same scores), the two are 'reused' and do not count toward max_new_dockings

small_observed_seed8.how: same as small_observed_seed7 with ga.seed 8 (different GA seed, same docking scores)

small_observed_limit5.how: max_new_dockings 5 (= population 4 + 1): docking_limit inside generation 2, partial

small_observed_limit5_reuse_two.how: max_new_dockings 5 with two reusable candidates: the limit binds later, so the same GA seed takes a longer path (G3: a different reusable set can change the path)

synthetic_ties_nulls.how: SYNTHETIC selection-logic input scores (not engine output) with ties (-5.0 x2, -7.5 x2, -6.0 x2) and two no-score candidates (one null_result, one failed); elite 2, tournament 3, neighbours 3 (T2: was 2, below the spec range 3-30), random_fraction 0.5

synthetic_no_scored_parent.how: SYNTHETIC: every generation-1 pick has no score, so generation 2 fills every slot at random (no carried individual, no tournament call)

synthetic_pool_exhausted.how: SYNTHETIC: population 4, elite 0, 8 generations on 10 eligible: 4 + 4 + 2 picks, then no slot can be filled -> pool_exhausted after generation 3 (generation 3 has 2 individuals)

synthetic_no_change.how: SYNTHETIC: every score equal (-6.0), patience 1: generation 2 does not lower the running minimum -> no_change after generation 2

synthetic_filter_excluded.how: SYNTHETIC: pool candidates 1, 4 and 8 are filter-excluded (not eligible): never picked, never docked

small_pool_docking.how: real qvina2 through unmodified docking_worker.dock_row (receptor prepared once), docking env, two separate processes; first-mode qvina score (kcal/mol, Vina-family scoring function value, not an affinity); observations, not oracle values
